soalnya AES-CTR itu stream cipher, keystream-nya = E(K, nonce||counter). sama input = sama keystream. terus C = P xor keystream, jadi ya sama terus

AES-CTR tuh stream cipher: keystream = E(key, nonce||counter). enkripsi = cuma XOR plaintext sama keystream
